**Claim 115337 (carrier claim): denial-risk score**

The model gives this claim a denial probability of 0.1916. The validation-set average is 0.1805, so the claim is 1.06 times the average, or 1.1 percentage points above it. The claim is only slightly above average. The model's baseline is 0.1404.

The denial label in this project is synthetic. It was built from risk rules, so the score is not a prediction of a real payer decision.

**What the model weighs most:**
- **LINE_PLACE_OF_SRVC_CD (value 20)** is the largest upward push. It changes the odds by +55%. The project's data dictionary has no entry for this field, so I can't say what the value means.
- **HCPCS_CD (value null)** pushes the other way, changing the odds by −22%. The dictionary describes it as the procedure/service code billed. The value is missing on this claim.
- **TAX_NUM, PRNCPAL_DGNS_CD (T7432X) and LINE_NUM (7)** each add a small upward push, of +7%, +6% and +5%. The dictionary describes the diagnosis field as the principal diagnosis (ICD-10-CM). TAX_NUM and LINE_NUM are undocumented in the dictionary.
- **CARR_CLM_BLG_NPI_NUM** lowers the odds slightly, by 4%. It is also undocumented in the dictionary.

153 other features are not shown. The tools give no policy or CARC information for this claim, so I have nothing to add on those.
